entities.summary: Richard Alan "R. J." Umberger, Jr. is an American former professional ice hockey center. Drafted in the first round, 16th overall, in the 2001 NHL entry draft by the Vancouver Canucks, Umberger has played in the National Hockey League (NHL) for the Philadelphia Flyers and Columbus Blue Jackets.
